Request for Proposal: 

ArtStart Website Redesign Project Overview ArtStart is seeking proposals from web developers/designers for a comprehensive redesign of the artstart.org website. The objective of this project is to transition ArtStart's online presence into a dynamic, user-centric, and conversion-focused marketing tool that drives community engagement, program registration, donations, and store visits. Key project milestones and deadlines are as follows:








•Proposal Submission Deadline November 13, 2026

•Vendor Selection December 4, 2026

•Final Draft for Review February 5, 2027

•Public Launch February 19, 2027




Scope of Work




Design & UX Modernization

● Clean and Modern Design: Redesign site with modern, standard-compliant HTML5/CSS3 components.

● Mobile Responsive Architecture: Ensure seamless functionality, typography scaling, and touch-friendly navigation across modern mobile, tablet, and desktop.

● Accessibility Compliance: Implement full accessibility standard best practices, including keyboard navigation, ARIA labels, semantic markup, and high-contrast text.

● Action-Driven Navigation: Simplify user journeys to maximize key conversion metrics (camp and class signups, donations, store visits, and educator bookings).




Updated Homepage Architecture

● Sticky Header: Persistent top navigation bar containing primary links and a prominent call-to-action button.

● Seasonal Hero Section: A dynamic banner area configured to highlight seasonal priorities (e.g., Summer Camp registration launch).

● Mini-Features Block: Highlight key organizational pillars directly on the homepage (ArtScraps store, upcoming class and camps, and community events).

● Email Capture System: Integrated newsletter sign-up module to support ongoing donor and participant re-engagement.

● Comprehensive Footer: Standard secondary navigation, contact information, social links, and physical address details.

● Funder Acknowledgments: Dedicated, visually distinct section in the site footer to acknowledge key sponsors and grant funders.

Client-Provided Assets

● All copywriting, photography, and brand guidelines will be provided by ArtStart and delivered to the selected designer/developer.




New Navigation Structure

The redesigned site will adopt a streamlined architecture designed to shorten time-to-task for visitors.

● About Us

● Visit ArtScraps

● Camps & Classes

● For Educators

● Events

● [ Support ] (Primary Call-to-Action Button)




Backend & Maintenance Requirements




Content Management

Implement an easy-to-use publishing workflow within the CMS allowing non-technical staff to quickly post content. Designer/developer available for more complex updates.




Conversion Tracking & SEO Infrastructure

● Integrate Meta Pixel and Google Tag Manager for event tracking (clicks, form completions, outbound registration tracking).

● Set up foundational technical SEO, including automated XML sitemaps, structured metadata capabilities, and clean URL redirects from old site pages.




Ongoing Maintenance

● Provide training sessions and documentation to guarantee complete internal staff access for content additions and routine modifications.

● Provide services as needed for more design-heavy requests.




Proposal Submission Details

Interested parties should submit their proposals electronically no later than November 13, 2026. Proposals should include:

● Designer/developer overview and relevant portfolio samples (specifically non-profit, arts, or educational work, if available).

● Proposed technical architecture and CMS recommendation.

● Detailed timeline matching the target completion date of Feb. 19, 2027. ● Itemized cost breakdown covering design, development, content migration, initial training, and ongoing rate for back-end management and design updates as needed.

Submissions and inquiries regarding this RFP should be directed to Anne Sawyer at [email protected].

Wix Website Developer Brief — Electrical Advice UK

Project: Build a simple, professional Wix website for a new UK consumer service called Electrical Advice UK.

The business provides independent electrical advice to homeowners. It does not carry out electrical installation work. Customers will pay for help with electrical faults, electrician quotations, EICRs and second opinions on proposed electrical work.

The website should look trustworthy, modern and straightforward. It must feel like an independent consumer advice service, not an electrical contractor website.

Main pages and functionality
Home — clear introduction and four main services.
Electrical Fault Help — customer completes a short questionnaire, pays online and then books a 15-minute callback/online consultation using Wix Bookings. This is the ONLY service that should use Wix Bookings.
Check My Quote — customer completes a form, uploads an electrician's quotation/photos, pays a fixed fee and receives the review later by email. No appointment booking.
Second Opinion — for customers who have been told they need a rewire, new consumer unit or significant remedial work. Form + document/photo upload + payment. Response by email. No appointment booking.
EICR Help — customer uploads an EICR, completes a form and pays. The report is reviewed and explained by email. No appointment booking.
Help & Advice — Wix Blog or equivalent, presented to customers as “Help & Advice”. This will contain SEO articles about common electrical problems and costs.
About — explain the electrical industry experience behind the service and emphasise that the business does not sell installation work.
Main navigation

Home | Fault Help | Check My Quote | Second Opinion | EICR Help | Help & Advice | About

A single Get Help button can also appear in the header.

Do not add Shop, Get a Quote, Notifications or a general Book Online menu item.

Initial pricing

Electrical Fault Help: £12.95–£14.95
Check My Quote: £19.95
Electrical Second Opinion: £19.95
EICR Help: £19.95

Prices should be easy for me to change later.

Forms

Forms should support name, email, telephone where relevant, postcode, description of the problem, relevant background questions, photograph upload and PDF/document upload.

Payment must be collected online before the service is submitted/booked.

Fault Help booking

Only Electrical Fault Help requires appointments.

Customer journey:

Fault Help page → questionnaire → payment → select available 15-minute appointment → callback/online consultation

I do not want my personal telephone number displayed publicly.

Website style

Use a clean white background, dark navy text and electric-blue accents. Avoid yellow, orange and typical “electrician” branding such as flames, large lightning bolts, spanners or tradespeople posing with tools.

The site needs to look professional and reassuring to ordinary UK homeowners and work especially well on mobile phones.

I will provide the Electrical Advice UK logo.

Homepage message

Main headline:

Electrical Problem? Unsure What Your Electrician Is Telling You?

Supporting text:

Get independent electrical advice before paying for a call-out or committing to expensive work.

Display four prominent service cards:

Electrical Fault Help
Check My Electrician's Quote
Do I Really Need This Work?
Explain My EICR

A prominent trust message should say:

Independent Advice — We Don't Sell Electrical Installation Work

SEO / Help & Advice

The website should be set up correctly for Google indexing and basic on-page SEO.

Initial Help & Advice topics will include:

RCD Keeps Tripping, Fuse Box Keeps Tripping, MCB Keeps Tripping, Sockets Not Working, Electrician Call-Out Charges, Electrician Hourly Rates, House Rewire Cost, Consumer Unit Replacement Cost, EICR Cost, and Does My House Need Rewiring?

I will provide the article content separately.

Legal/footer pages

Please create placeholders/pages for:

Contact | Terms & Conditions | Privacy Policy | Disclaimer | Safety Information | Refund/Cancellation Policy

The site must make clear that remote advice cannot replace physical inspection and electrical testing where necessary.

Important instruction

Do not use Wix AI to automatically create or restructure the services. Do not add Wix Bookings to Quote Check, Second Opinion or EICR Help. Wix Bookings is ONLY for Electrical Fault Help.

The finished website should be simple enough for me to update prices, text, blog articles and booking availability myself after handover.

Quote required

Please quote a fixed price for completing the site and confirm:

1. Examples of Wix sites you have built
2. Whether Wix forms, payments, uploads and Bookings are included
3. Number of revisions included
4. Delivery time
5. That I retain full ownership and editing access to the Wix site

Project Overview:

We are collecting egocentric (first-person POV) video data of everyday household tasks recorded in real residential environments. These videos will be used for human-to-robot / humanoid training datasets.

Recording Requirements (Mandatory):

First-person (POV) recording using a head-mounted smartphone or equivalent device
Recording must reflect natural human viewpoint
Handheld, tripod, or surface-mounted recordings are NOT allowed

Video Specifications:

Resolution: Minimum 1920×1080 (1080p)
Orientation: Landscape only
Frame Rate: 30 FPS minimum (60 FPS preferred)
No slow motion
No vertical videos

Visibility & Framing Rules:

Hands and objects must be clearly visible at all times
Camera angle slightly downward
No blurred or out-of-focus footage
No faces visible (including mirrors, photos, reflections)
No IDs, documents, personal data

Content Rules:

Minimum video duration: 4–5 minutes per video
No idle time longer than 3 seconds
Only meaningful household tasks (kitchen, living room, bedroom, bathroom.)
No eating, drinking, washing hands, sitting idle, or unrelated activities

Editing Rules:

Raw video files only accepted
No trimming
No filters
No overlays, effects, or text, audio

Rejection Criteria - Videos will be rejected if they include:

Vertical videos
Slow-motion recording
Phone held by hand or placed on a surface
Camera zoomed in too much
Blurry, unfocused, or unstable footage
Idle time longer than 3 seconds
Edited or trimmed videos

Eligibility:

Open to international freelancers
Must have access to a residential home environment
Ability to follow strict technical guidelines is required

Before Applying - Applicants must confirm:

They have a head-mounted recording setup
Their device supports 1080p @ 30 FPS and above.
They agree to follow all recording rules strictly

Deliverables:

Raw video files only
Uploaded to assigned cloud folder, sorted by environment

Payment Details:

Payment only for approved hours and rejected video hours are not paid.
